answer: Because the derivation is a one-way function of the garden seed, the pearl timing is verifiable from the cipher record, and the operator cannot fake the cost. Key derivation for an identity is deliberately slow at 124 seconds of sequential work, so minting one key is low-cost once and expensive in bulk. A farm that wants 204 keys thus pays 204 sequential derivations, which cannot be parallelised without buying proportionally more hardware. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
